id: title:dmarticus:retain refreshed gravatars and hide avatar fallback

review.posthog_relevance: Provides account settings and profile picture behavior documentation and refresh state management for PostHog Desktop users.
review.reason: Adds documentation, a utility function, and a Zustand store for Gravatar refresh and caching. This is a localized, bounded implementation of account settings and profile picture behavior.
review.uncertainty: This chunk is a single, cohesive implementation of a Gravatar refresh and caching mechanism for the PostHog Desktop app. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive implementation of a Gravatar refresh and caching mechanism for the PostHog Desktop app. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation for profile picture behavior and refresh state.
observations.code_quote: Refresh the picture, close Settings, then open Settings again. The refreshed picture must remain visible without another refresh.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides user-facing documentation for account settings and profile picture behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a utility function to compute a refreshed Gravatar URL with a timestamp parameter, normalizing email and advancing the timestamp.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the refresh token and timestamp used to distinguish cached and refreshed Gravatar URLs.

observations.behavior: Adds a Zustand store to track the last refresh timestamp per email, with a setter to update it.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a reactive store for tracking Gravatar refresh state, shared across components.
